description: List remembered notes visible to this run in id order, notes saved earlier first, with their usage. limit is an integer from 1 to 50 (default 20). For more notes, pass the returned next_cursor as cursor until next_cursor is null; do not increase limit beyond 50. include_withdrawn also shows notes that were superseded, for maintenance work.

cursor.description: Pass next_cursor from the preceding page unchanged; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Notes per page: integer from 1 to 50; defaults to 20.
